coordinates.locator: OpenStreetMap way 104894934 (building "корпус 1", description "Синхрофазотрон, Нуклотрон") and way 104894941 (linear accelerator) at the Veksler and Baldin Laboratory of High Energy Physics
coordinates.note: Campus-grade point (400 m precision): the OSM outline of the building tagged "Synchrophasotron, Nuclotron" beside the linear accelerator. The NICA collider, Booster, the MPD hall and the BM@N and SPD areas lie within about 1 km; no fetched source gives their coordinates. The JINR news says the MPD hall is half a kilometre from the accelerators' main control room.
coordinates.quote: On 25 March 2025, run 1 at the NICA Accelerator Complex was initiated at the Laboratory of High Energy Physics at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research.

name: JINR VBLHEP accelerator complex (Nuclotron and NICA), Dubna
notes: Placement for BM@N (Nuclotron beam), the MPD and SPD halls at NICA.

summary.plain: The accelerator complex of JINR's Veksler and Baldin Laboratory of High Energy Physics in Dubna, with the superconducting Nuclotron synchrotron, the Booster and the NICA collider, and the halls of the BM@N, MPD and SPD experiments.
summary.technical: VBLHEP accelerator complex, Dubna: Nuclotron (1993), Booster and the NICA collider rings; campus-grade point from the OSM building tagged as the home of the synchrophasotron and Nuclotron.
